question.title: Çerez tercihleri
question.question: Which consent overlay is present and what exact choices does it offer? Focus on the “Çerez tercihleri” screen.

request.systemPrompt:
You are the vision subsystem of a web-automation agent. A screenshot of the current browser viewport is attached. Describe what is on screen so the planning agent can decide its next action.

Format — keep it terse, structured, no flowery prose:

1) Page purpose: one line (e.g. "GitHub repo issue list", "Gmail compose", "Stripe checkout form").
2) Visible text: list the EXACT strings on buttons, links, headings, tabs, and menu items. Quote them verbatim. Do not paraphrase.
3) Inputs: list each visible form field with its label, placeholder, current value, and whether it is focused/disabled.
4) State signals: loading spinners, toasts, modals, error banners, success messages, CAPTCHAs, cookie/consent banners, overlays.
5) Blockers: anything that would prevent the next likely action (overlay, disabled submit, missing data, auth prompt).
6) Unknowns: if you cannot read something clearly, say so. Do not guess numbers, names, or identifiers.

Rules: no prose intro, no conclusion, no "this screenshot shows...", no layout description unless it matters (e.g. "left nav is collapsed"). If the page is blank or still loading, say that in one line and stop.
request.userText: Describe this screenshot of the current browser viewport for a web-automation agent. Follow the format in the system prompt.

response.content:
1) Page purpose: Blog/article page ("Field Notes") on a site called WebScene, with a cookie-consent gate.

2) Visible text:
- "WebScene" (logo, top-left)
- "Home"
- "Workspace"
- "Activity"
- "Field Notes" (heading)
- "Independent stories about design, technology, and cities."
- "A long-form article continues underneath the privacy surface."
- "Çerez tercihleri" (cookie banner heading)
- "Zorunlu çerezler kapatılamaz."
- "Tümünü kabul et" (button)
- "Yalnızca gerekli" (button)

3) Inputs: None visible.

4) State signals:
- Dark cookie-consent banner fixed at bottom of viewport.
- Large empty gray/lavender rectangle in the main card — appears to be a placeholder or content intentionally hidden pending consent (the caption "continues underneath the privacy surface" suggests content is gated behind cookie acceptance).
- Circular gradient avatar icon top-right (no readable text).

5) Blockers:
- Cookie banner overlays the bottom of the page; likely must click "Tümünü kabul et" or "Yalnızca gerekli" to dismiss and reveal the article content.
- Article body is not rendered/visible in the placeholder area, so no article links or text are actionable yet.

6) Unknowns:
- Contents of the gray placeholder rectangle (image vs. hidden article text) — nothing legible inside.
- Avatar icon has no readable label; target page unknown.
- Whether "Yalnızca gerekli" also unlocks the content or only "Tümünü kabul et" does.
